desc: The garden's hub and zones (briefs/design/GARDEN.md 10; scripts/home/garden_zones.gd, docs/decisions/0022-garden-zones.md). Save.d zones = {id: {open}}, rec zone = the Boki's home zone. zones: name, colour (its stone's glow and card), types (lean.json types; the 18 split five ways), trait (Care trait it matches), game (what its card says is played there) and wayseed_from (where the card says the Wayseed comes from).
start_doc: The zone open from the start and the home of every Boki in an older save.
lean_key_doc: Lean points (of Evo.LEAN_FULL 24) a Boki needs in one of a zone's types to wake it: about two meals.
hop_fade_s_doc: Seconds the Waystone lights up and fades before the zone loads under the ink wipe.
hop_max_s_doc: Seconds from pressing E to having control in the zone (--load-check=hop judges it).
walk_s_doc: Seconds a Boki you sent has to reach the return pad before it blinks out where it is.
ask_chance_doc: Chance, each time a Boki that would thrive elsewhere picks what to do, that it goes to wait at the return pad (once per load).
ask_s_doc: Seconds it waits at the pad with its bubble before it gives up and wanders off.

hub_hints.start_s_doc: Seconds after you arrive in the hub before its first hint can show.
hub_hints.gap_s_doc: Seconds between two hub hints: one at a time, each longer than its 6 s on screen.
hub_hints.near_m_doc: Metres from the place a hint is about (the Waystone, the nest corner) at which it shows.

list.text: The Waystone: step on the ring and press {interact} to travel.
The nest corner: pair two Boki here, hatch eggs and pass on gifts.
A dark stone needs two keys: a Wayseed and a Boki leaning its way. Its card shows both.

hub_hints.list_doc: First-time hints, in order, each once per save (Save.d tutorial hub_hints): id, at (waystone or nest), needs (a hint seen first), locked (only while a zone sleeps), text.

wayseed_from: a lair of a matching type on a run, or the Drift Trader once a week
